surfaces.system.md: Keep v4's instructions. Add, in the wording of lesson 10: 'This work is multistep: think carefully after every tool result, not only at the start.' after the opening line; the five-step write rubric (Request, Procedure, Record, Arguments, Order) after the search line; 'State a fee, rate, limit, eligibility or "can't" only from a sentence you read in a document; invent no restriction.'; 'Give a user tool (give_discoverable_user_tool) before telling the customer to use it, with every argument's full value.'; and replace 'disputed_amount = the full transaction' with doc _031's amount in error (full charge for fraud/unauthorized; the overcharge for incorrect amount; the cash not dispensed for an ATM shortfall; one copy of a duplicate), transaction type from the record, noticed/discovery date from when the customer first noticed. Keep the liability sentence. Tasks 036, 038, 055, 068, 069, 072, 082-088, 016, 025, 063, 067.
surfaces.helper.py: Keep v2/v4 helper. In open_bank_account, after the suffix strip, a class ending in 'Saver' (case-insensitive) gets ' Account' appended (doc _004). Task 056.
surfaces.checks.py: Keep A-G and check_reply. Add H close_debit_card (doc _025 req 4-5, _026): blocked until get_bank_account_transactions has run for the card's account (any account if unknown); blocked when the customer asked to freeze and nothing was frozen here; blocked while the card was frozen here and not unfrozen (tasks 079, 080). Widen B: pay_credit_card_from_checking while the customer asked to close a credit card needs dispute history + pending replacements (task 046). Transfers (doc _042 tiers as data): offer/flyer raised + human asked → a Tier 2-4 reason is sent back once naming customer_demands_after_unavailable_offer_refusal; any other Tier 2-4 reason is sent back once with the Tier-1 list; after an 'already exists' result, a transfer is sent back once (continue the procedure) (tasks 008, 051). A credit-card dispute marked eligible for provisional credit beyond cc_015 item 4's count (history + filed here) is sent back with the count (task 041). update_transaction_rewards is blocked unless a tool result showed that transaction RESOLVED/APPROVED (cc_004, task 027). check_reply: a user tool named but not given, or a masked/partial id, with a use instruction → sent back once (task 055); restriction wording (violat, misuse, against our policy, not permitted, not allowed, prohibited) → sent back once to cite the document or drop it (task 016); a referral-eligibility/recommendation answer before the accounts are read → sent back once (tasks 098, 099). Every new rule uses _once.
surfaces.memory.py: Record: transactions read by account_id; frozen and unfrozen card ids; the customer's freeze, card-close, credit-card-close and recommendation requests; user tools given; transaction ids shown RESOLVED or APPROVED in tool results; the last 'already exists' result; category products listed (ls/grep results) and documents read; accounts read; verified (log_verification succeeded); offers/promotions/flyers the customer raised; referral talk; credit-card disputes in the history within 12 months and eligible ones filed here.
surfaces.guidance.py: Within 600 chars, add: after an 'already exists' result, continue the procedure (re-check eligibility, decide), do not transfer; once verified and before accounts are read, read them before judging eligibility, tenure or balances; when a recommendation is requested, name the category's listed-but-unread products; in the human-request note add doc _042's highest-tier rule. Keep v4's notes.

risks: check H could block a legitimate close_debit_card where transactions are irrelevant; it blocks once per key, so it costs one extra read at most, and doc _025 req 4-5 needs the read anyway.
The transfer reason check could push a wrong Tier-1 reason when the customer's offer mention is incidental; it sends back once, and the agent may keep its reason on the second attempt.
check_reply restriction wording may fire on a correctly cited restriction (e.g. dispute limits); the message asks to cite the document, so a cited reply goes through on the rewrite.
The referral check_reply could delay a pure FAQ answer about referrals; it asks only for the account read, which doc _048 needs for tenure.
The longer system.md (rubric) competes with policy text; it replaces the wrong disputed_amount line and adds about 900 characters, within lesson 3's budget.
The Saver suffix helper applies only to classes ending exactly in 'Saver', so personal savings classes are untouched.
